caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted bust of a woman, rendered in shades of white, cream, and subtle soft yellow highlights to suggest a stone or marble texture. The sculpture features detailed, curly hair, and the woman is dressed in a classical-style garment with draped, gathered fabric and decorative elements at the shoulders and chest. The figure is shown from the thighs upward, and the head is slightly tilted upward with the eyes gazing above at an angle. The entire sculpture is centered against a uniformly textured, deep blue background without any additional objects or elements present. The composition consists only of the sculpted female figure in the middle of the image, with a strong contrast between the light tones of the sculpture and the dark blue backdrop.
title: Figurehead "Marie"
